rows.title: Publish the Apps Script push that carries the go-live code
rows.how: In the Apps Script editor: Deploy → Manage deployments → the deployment the platform calls → pencil → New version. It is live once the platform's log says the engine build changed to the build stamp of this push.
rows.requires: The code push is done, and a dry run shows nothing left to push
rows.effect: The go-live code serves from the deployment the relay calls.

rows.title: Lock down the server
rows.how: Key-only login, one key per registered device; PermitRootLogin prohibit-password; PasswordAuthentication no (the same for the ops account, or remove it); keys nobody recognises removed; fail2ban on.
rows.requires: A live key session stays open while it is changed
rows.effect: Only the registered devices can reach the server.

rows.title: Uninstall Shift Board
rows.how: Open the App Hub, find Shift Board and uninstall it. Its screens live in Calendar Builder, and old /app/shiftboard links redirect there.
rows.requires: Its screens are in Calendar Builder, and old links redirect
rows.effect: Shift Board leaves the App Hub; its screens stay in Calendar Builder.

rows.title: Master Messenger: the online line on Message Submissions

params.text: Asa LifeCare Systems are Online, go there for this kind of request: https://asamylife.asalifecare.com/
params.note: the form's four answers and Sent?
params.script: New Group Message.gs reads the last row and writes Sent? by position

rows.how: Writes the line in row 1, right of the header and over empty cells. The last row does not move, so the form's appends and the script's last-row read are untouched.
rows.requires: House managers can open Smart Comms → Broadcast
rows.effect: Message Submissions shows a blood-red line that sends house managers to the platform.

rows.title: Communication Log: the online line on Communication Master

params.text: Asa LifeCare Systems are Online, go there for this kind of request: https://asamylife.asalifecare.com/

rows.how: Writes the same line in row 1 of the tab found by its id (its title ends in a space), right of the header and over empty cells.
rows.effect: Communication Master shows the same blood-red line.

rows.title: Retire the Master Messenger form and the hand-typed texts
rows.system: Master Messenger · Google Form, Smart Comms
rows.how: Close the Master Messenger form with a closed message that points to the platform. House managers use Smart Comms → Broadcast; the recruiting texts come from Smart Comms → Recruiting. To make this automatic: Edit → Close a Google Form, with the Master Messenger book and tab id 1542343678.
rows.requires: Broadcast and Recruiting are open to the people who sent those texts
rows.effect: The form stops taking blasts, and nobody is texted twice.

rows.title: Close the time-off Google Form
rows.how: Responses → turn off Accepting responses, with a closed message that points to the platform's Time Off. To make this automatic: Edit → Close a Google Form, with this form's id.
rows.requires: The Time Off migration has imported every current request; do it the same day as 8
rows.effect: Time off is requested only on the platform.

rows.title: Switch off 'Update Staff Time Off Requests'
rows.how: In the Master Calendar Creator's script project, Triggers → delete the trigger of 'Update Staff Time Off Requests'. No handler here can reach another project's triggers, so this stays manual.
rows.effect: The old script stops writing R/O for requests nobody approved.

rows.title: The House Repair Google Form gives way to the platform
rows.how: Close the House Repair Requests form with a closed message that points to the platform's House Repair. To make this automatic: Edit → Close a Google Form, with the form's edit id — the published id cannot be opened.
rows.requires: Staff can file a request in House Repair: its New button is open to them
rows.effect: Repair requests are filed in House Repair on the platform.

rows.title: Rotate the Quo API key
rows.how: Make a new key in the Quo workspace, put it in the Hub's Script Property in the same minute, then revoke the old key.
rows.requires: Actions 6 and 4 are done: the external projects that hold the key are retired
rows.effect: The key the external projects carry stops working; the platform keeps texting.
